Ahoy everyone, Ronway here. I have sadly been unable to start a regular stream, due to my wonky schedule never being the same. But have no fear my cultist, for I will instead start streaming nearly everytime I play SotM: The Video Game. You may be wondering why I would stream nearly everytime I play. Well it's simple. I am playing it anyways, so it pretty much hurts nothing to have a streaming device going while I am playing.

Most of the time I will probably have my mic muted, purely because there may not be anyone watching live while I am playing alone and I am not very good at talking to myself. However, I will do my best to watch out for people in the Twitch chat and will respond when able. There may be times where my wife is sleeping (she has the overnight shift) so I will exclusively have to type. Hope to talk to you all soon!
